T01.question: Why might a technician with a smaller build work more efficiently with a different set of tools?
T01.answer: A technician with a smaller build may work more efficiently when tools and equipment are tailored to their size, because one size does not fit everyone. [S1]

T05.question: The sample job card in Figure 14-35 marks the task as a duplicate inspection. How many people does it say are needed to do the work and inspect it?
T05.answer: Two people: one to perform the task and one to inspect it. [S1]
